hook_text: Will the tank warning battery last six months? Three lines of arithmetic say yes, and here is why.
clip_script: Every Ohm's law sum: known and wanted, formula, numbers with units, calculate, answer with a sense check. Convert milliamps to amps first. Series: same current, resistances add, volts shared. LED resistor: battery minus 2, over the current. 4.5 volts: 250 ohms. 9 volts: 700. Parallel: each branch gets the full volts, work each alone, add the currents. LED branch 5.3 milliamps, buzzer 15, both on 20. Battery 2000 milliamp-hours. Standby: reed switch open, zero current, years. Warning: 380 hours on the LED. Six months is easy because it sleeps.
visual_style: Whiteboard five-line layout; a series pair with volts split 2.6 and 1.9; a parallel pair with currents adding; 2000 / 5.3 = 380 hours; a sleeping battery icon.
pacing: Five lines, convert, series, LED, parallel, PAT branches, battery, sleeps.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and calculate the resistor for a 2 volt LED at 15 milliamps on 6 volts.
